patient_summary: Adult ED patient with dyspnea and chest pain, moderate Wells category (synthetic).
pretest_source: Wells 2001 Results, p. 102: moderate-probability group, 55 of 339 (16.2%, CI 12.5-20.6%) had PE.
result_shown: a filling defect in a pulmonary artery on CTPA

sources.quantity: CTA 2x2 (conclusive scans): 150 TP, 31 FN, 25 FP, 567 TN, so sensitivity 150/181 (83%), specificity 567/592 (96%); LRs computed from these counts (not published)
observed CTA PPV 92% (93/101; CI 84-96) and NPV 89% (121/136; CI 82-93) in the intermediate (Wells moderate) stratum; sensitivity target only

conditional_independence: Each case applies a single likelihood ratio (the LR for the result shown) to a single pretest probability, so no conditional-independence assumption is needed. If findings were ever combined, the LRs would be multiplied assuming conditional independence given disease status.
notes: Prior (Wells 2001 ED cohort) and LRs (PIOPED II conclusive scans) come from different cohorts. PIOPED II's observed PPV/NPV in the intermediate stratum are stored as sensitivity_targets, not as the primary target. LRs apply to conclusive scans only (51 of 824 CTAs inconclusive). Wells 2001 and PIOPED II both use the Wells score tiers (<2 low, 2-6 moderate, >6 high). Wells score as written in the note: DVT signs 0; PE leading consideration with pneumonia and pleurisy less likely 3; HR 108, 1.5; immobilization or surgery 0; prior PE or DVT 0; hemoptysis 0; malignancy 0. Total 4.5 = moderate. Unscored findings neutral (T 37.0, SpO2 96% RA, clear lungs, ECG sinus tachycardia only, no troponin).

sensitivity_targets.label: PIOPED II observed CTA PPV, intermediate clinical probability
